senses.gloss: m. (dial. for כַּרָּא, cmp. גּוּנְדְּרָא) pitcher, pot. [Pes. 111ᵇ, v. כִּנָּרָא.]—Pl. כַּנְרֵּי.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 30a">Pes. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>מזבני כ׳</he> sellers of earthen ware.
<cite ref="Pesachim 30a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אשוו זביני אכַּנְדַּיְיכוּ</he> (not <he>דיכי …</he>; Ms. M. <he>אשוו זבינייכו</he>) set a fair price on your pots.—

<cite ref="Chullin 48b:1">Ḥull. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>דקיימו כ׳ כ׳</he> lungs upon which there are pot-like excrescences.—[<cite ref="Berakhot 40b">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00876"><he>כִּנָּרָא</he></cite>.]
